identity.title: [provider] Add first-class Moonshot/Kimi K3 provider support

values.summary: Implemented first-class Moonshot/Kimi K3 provider support in the bound issue worktree and remediated exact-review findings before publication. The change adds native kimi/moonshot provider-kind routing, the kimi:k3 profile, Kimi setup generation, bounded provider documentation, runtime adapter reasoning_effort propagation, and issue-owned deterministic tests. Review remediation canonicalizes outbound Kimi reasoning_effort whitespace, follows Moonshot's documented Kimi K3 default of max when reasoning_effort is omitted, and refreshes validation evidence at the exact source head. Integration remains worktree-only pending fresh exact review and PR publication.
actual_changes: Added native Kimi/Moonshot provider support in adl/src/provider/http_family.rs and wired it through adl/src/provider/mod.rs.
Added kimi:k3 profile materialization and reasoning_effort validation in adl/src/provider/profiles.rs.
Canonicalized moonshot as a Kimi provider alias in adl/src/provider_substrate.rs.
Propagated Kimi runtime-adapter reasoning_effort in adl/src/provider_adapter.rs and validated Kimi K3 reasoning values in adl/src/provider_communication.rs.
Added adl provider setup kimi/moonshot support in adl/src/cli/provider_cmd.rs and adl/src/cli/usage.rs.
Added issue-owned integration test target adl/tests/provider_moonshot_kimi_k3.rs.
Remediated review finding r5 by trimming outbound Kimi runtime reasoning_effort after validation.
Remediated review finding r5 by defaulting omitted Kimi K3 reasoning_effort to max and documenting that ADL follows Moonshot's OpenAI-compatible API default.

actual_validation.purpose: Focused issue-owned Moonshot/Kimi K3 provider integration proof, including default max reasoning_effort and trimmed outbound runtime effort regressions.
Strict lint proof for touched Rust provider surfaces.
Rust formatting check for touched sources and tests.
